reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A specific process links to a resolvable general process description; the SensorML standard explicitly uses manufacturer model → individual equipment as an example.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A model designation is not automatically the general process URI, nor proof of an individually installed unit.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: One required uniqueId identifies the described process or object, which may be an individual or a reusable process description.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A SensorML process ID does not automatically establish a physical manufacturer's serial number or a CSAPI System resource ID.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: A PhysicalSystem models a physically situated aggregate process whose description includes components and their connections.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Not every referenced arrangement is a verified deployed, permanently assembled individual; the standard also represents reusable datasheets.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: PhysicalComponent covers a physical process not further divided in the description; PhysicalSystem can list physical or computational process components.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A SensorML process component is not automatically a separate manufactured module, a replaceable part or an installed constituent.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Connections explicitly describe process information-flow source and destination links, including ports of nested sub-processes.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A process/data-flow connection does not prove a physical cable, an electrical bus or externally connected hardware.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Deployment descriptions identify location, platform, and referenced deployed systems, plus deployment-specific configuration.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A station or platform location is not automatically an individual probe survey; no exact historical service interval can be invented.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: ProcessMethod describes how input values and parameters are converted to outputs and may reference implementations.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: An algorithmic process description is not an actual performed observation, a verified running program, or automatically an OMS observing Procedure.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Named process outputs may be ObservableProperty or SWE Common DataComponents including Quantity and data aggregates.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A process output declaration is not necessarily a transmitted native field, physical channel, SWE record value or CSAPI DataStream schema.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: SensorML models ObservableProperty as a physical observable stimulus/property that may appear as a detector input, actuator output or parameter.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: ObservableProperty is not itself a measured Quantity or a performed Observation; SWE field types and numerical results remain distinct.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Configurable processes may advertise selectable modes with collections of settings. When a modes list is present, the normative model requires at least two.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A declared capability/mode list is not a source-observed active mode or actual applied settings from a fielded individual.

heldNativeLeads.negativeBoundary: Contacts can include manufacturers, owners or maintenance staff but have distinct responsibility roles. A contact is not a guaranteed manufacturer-name field.

heldNativeLeads.term: Serial number in instance-specific identification metadata
heldNativeLeads.negativeBoundary: The standard's OEM instance example lists serial as possible additional information; no universal dedicated numeric hardware serial attribute was established by this review.
History events can describe calibration, maintenance and deployment; they do not by themselves prove exact equipment role intervals, exact swap time or hardware serial join.
Source supports deployment spatial/mounting context, not an individually surveyed probe point or an authenticated as-operated station graph.
Performance/energy design properties may be described but do not establish actual battery charge, health, or observed runtime.
A data/process interface and connected process flow are not automatically a LoRaWAN port, SDI-12 wire, physical bus or verified active reporting path.
Specific configured descriptions are source-representable, but a manufacturer's design setting is not evidence of the currently effective setting.
Process/transform lineage may be documented, but the source does not prove a Campbell program executed or an AirGradient correction method is validated.
A statistical/qualified property supports mean-temperature semantics; it does not assert original event time, derived contributor identity or performed observations.

noClaims: No manufacturer installation inferred from published reference arrangement
No SensorML JSON instance schema conformance test of live equipment or CSAPI payload
No physical cable inferred from connections
No original NOAA resultTime or exact serial handoff instant invented
